name: daily-driver
notes: Declared T2 by the owner on 2026-10-15 (agent-hq decision mdviewer-tier-20261015, option a: 'T2, merge free'). Public browser Markdown-to-PDF editor deployed to Cloudflare Pages by direct upload. Push and merge are free within the proving, review and aging gates; CI (typecheck, lint, unit, build on Node 22 and 24, Playwright E2E) must be green at the head. Merging is not deploying: live deploys run from main only and stay owner-held under ACTION_ITEMS AI-9 until production reviewers and environment-scoped credentials exist. Reassess before accounts, server-side user data or automatic deploys.
